title: Frequently Asked Questions | Unique Visa Services
description: Answers to common questions about working with Unique Visa Services: fees, appointments, regulation and timescales.

faqs.q: Do I need an adviser, or can I apply myself?
faqs.a: You can apply directly. Many people use us because a missing document or misunderstood rule can mean a refusal, a lost fee and months of delay.

faqs.q: Do I need to visit your office?
faqs.a: No. You can meet us in Manchester, or we can work with you by phone, video call and email from anywhere in the UK.

faqs.q: How much do your services cost?
faqs.a: Our fee depends on the service and is agreed before we start. Government fees are paid separately. See our fees page.
Yes. We are registered with the Immigration Advice Authority, reference F200700144.
No adviser can guarantee a decision. What we can do is make sure your application is complete, accurate and well evidenced.
